This module provides a robust caching mechanism designed for high-performance applications where
data needs to be retrieved efficiently but must also expire after a certain period. It combines
Least Recently Used (LRU) eviction policies with Time-To-Live (TTL) constraints, ensuring that
stale data is automatically removed while maintaining thread safety for multi-threaded environments.

Key Features:
- LRU Eviction: Removes the least recently used item when the cache reaches its capacity limit.
- TTL Expiry: Automatically removes entries that have exceeded their time-to-live duration.

- Customizable Capacity: The maximum number of items the cache can hold can be configured.
- Customizable TTL: The time-to-live for cache entries can be specified individually or globally.
- Callbacks: Support for callbacks that are triggered when items are accessed, added, or removed.
- Statistics: Track cache hits, misses, and eviction counts for monitoring and debugging.
- Serialization: Support for serializing and deserializing the cache state.
- Async Support: Async-safe operations for use in async environments (using asyncio.Lock).

Data Structures Used:
- OrderedDict: Maintains insertion order and allows O(1) access to the most recently used item.
- Locks: Uses threading.Lock for thread safety in the synchronous version and asyncio.Lock for async.
- Timestamps: Uses Unix timestamps for calculating TTL expiry times.

- Get/Set: O(1) amortized time complexity for get and set operations.
- Eviction: O(1) amortized time complexity when the cache is at capacity.

- O(n) where n is the maximum capacity of the cache.
